name: integer_below_int64_min
description: An integer one below the int64 minimum (-2^63-1 = -9223372036854775809) is out of the canonical numeric domain and MUST be rejected on decode. This pins the lower asymmetric edge: -9223372036854775808 is valid (fixture 019) but -9223372036854775809 is not. SPEC Section 2.3.2.
